label_match: casefold and remove all non-alphanumeric characters; require exact normalized match between a consensus genre class and the scorer's training-fold-selected genre tag
scorer: unchanged frozen target-masked MTG-Jamendo score replay
population: records in the canonical MTG manifest with a clean consensus annotation for the taxonomy
metric: tie-aware average precision for one-vs-rest consensus genre labels
support_rule: evaluate a taxonomy-label-fold block only when it has at least one positive and one negative consensus annotation and all three conditions have score records
aggregation: mean AP over supported matched labels within each taxonomy and fold, then mean over supported taxonomies within each fold; compare conditions in the same ten folds
interval: descriptive paired Student-t 95% interval over the ten artist folds
interpretation: external human-consensus genre target on previously used MTG tracks; a retrospective downstream diagnostic, not a prospective untouched data-source study or an audio-quality claim
